name: metadata
description: Metadata — multi-vertical metadata API (prepaid USDG credits, Reown Pay, x402)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @metadata/server" "npm run dev -w @metadata/web"
scripts.dev:named: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "portless api.metadata npm run dev -w @metadata/server" "portless metadata npm run dev -w @metadata/web"
scripts.build: npm run security:policy && npm run build -w @metadata/web
scripts.lint: biome lint packages/api/src apps/api/src apps/web/src edge/src scripts tests
scripts.check: npm run security:policy:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run edge:check
